name: Netherlands
price_index_source: default until finance sets it from purchasing power
payment_methods_note: payment methods are the providers list: every product reads the same list

vcard.note: A pack alone never turns cards on. Needs a signed issuer agreement, legal sign-off and the activation checklist.

vcard_card_networks_note: set from the issuer contract, never assumed
note: Generated from ISO 3166, ISO 4217, IANA tz and CLDR by tools/country_packs.py. Tax, fiscal workflow, partners and price index stay unconfirmed until a person confirms them; then copy the facts in and set source to curated.

invoice_numbering.note: services/invoicing.py rules; a country's tax authority may require more (for example a registered series). Set confirmed when a person checks the country.

legal_text.note: Set by the country's lawyer (ledger item country_legal_text). Until then nothing is printed as legal wording.

storefront.note: Set per country after the lawyer review (ledger item storefront_legal_review); unknown until then.

people.note: Set per country after the lawyer review (ledger item people_services_legal); unknown until then.
